context: Fresh evaluations of the complete rebuild made from the writing-plans plan.
evaluation_isolation: Each agent started with a fresh context and received its task, raw inputs, current skill path and installed runtime. Grader expectations, earlier solutions and research were excluded.

cases.verification: Fresh agent used installed production/debug core with jsdom; reviewed original and exercised the suggested correction in memory.
assertions: Initially hidden and visible null-removal failures reproduced
Persistent hide/show retained strict input identity and live draft
Valid current-node Status binding retained its span and updated styling
No files edited and no dependencies added
No unexpected console or debug errors
cases.verification_scope: Node/jsdom; no real-browser rendering or focus checks

cases.verification: Fresh agent wrote a focused check that failed on the original refresh behavior, then passed with production and debug core after the repair.
assertions: Existing collection and retained row/input identities preserved
Snapshot updates, insertions, removals and requested order applied
Arbitrary unique string IDs preserved, including empty, numeric-looking, Unicode and special names
Repeated error show/clear and truthy/falsey behavior retained
Clear, repeated clear, empty snapshots and repopulation passed
Input handling after refresh and later snapshot updates passed
No unexpected callback console errors
cases.verification_scope: Node/jsdom; no browser focus or layout checks

cases.verification: Fresh agent implemented text-mode SSR and the shared client handoff, then passed a reusable parser/interaction check in production and debug-component modes.
assertions: Parsed initial controls match valid Unicode text with LF line endings and both boolean states
Encoded state round-trips quotes, backslashes, entity text, Unicode, closing tags, CR/CRLF and isolated surrogates
Server output contains no script elements or inline event attributes
Live pre-hydration text and checkbox values survive replacement
ARIA updates repeatedly and immediate submission after a toggle captures current state
Pending save snapshots, duplicate prevention and rejection/retry behave correctly
Controls retain identity after hydration during ordinary updates
No unexpected console, jsdom or unhandled Promise errors
cases.verification_scope: Node/jsdom. Textarea and HTML parsing normalize CR/CRLF and HTML-invalid code points; exact control equality was checked for valid Unicode LF text. No real-browser layout, autofill or complete focus/scroll coverage.

cases.reason: This maintenance prompt requires an existing project intentionally pinned to an older VanJS version. No such project was supplied for this rebuild.

independent_review.scope: Complete rebuilt instructions, references, evaluation catalog, actual-package runner/report, and installed sources.
independent_review.record_limit: The reviewer did not inspect fresh task solutions; the parent recorded task results from their returned verification and reviewed the generated implementations.

limitations: No comparison experiment measured model improvement over the previous skill.
The historical records apply to these reviewed files and observed runs; rerun relevant checks after substantive changes.
Task command lines describe the isolated evaluation workspaces; the package supplies prompts and raw fixtures rather than the agents' generated solutions.

reviewed_ui_fields.short_description: Build and review reliable VanJS, VanX, and Mini-Van code
reviewed_ui_fields.default_prompt: Use $vanjs-development to implement or review this task with the project's installed VanJS packages.

ui_metadata_note: Authored UI fields were verified semantically after save; export may normalize YAML and add icon or policy metadata.
